note: Arabic Spelling. Each name is the plain spelling of a prophet's name; the test checks that the same letters (marks removed, alef forms and alef maqsura normalised) occur as a word in assets/quran/quran.json, and 'ref' is the first verse found. English names follow the Messengers' tree (assets/family/tree.json). No audio and no meaning other than the name itself. Names whose Qur'anic spelling drops a letter (Salih, Sulayman, Ibrahim, Ismail, Ishaq, Harun, Adam) are left out.
